coordinate_system.rotation_conversion: R_ros = C * R_unity * transpose(C); do not swap Euler angles.
coordinate_system.axis_conversion: Revolute angular axes are pseudovectors: Unity axis = -C_inverse * ROS axis. Serialized articulation anchor * local +X is recorded below.
coordinate_system.registration_note: Defines a source-aligned ROS/Isaac frame. Does not assert that an existing USD world or imported robot root already uses that frame.
